determinism: donor new and host SA baselines bitwise == Stage-A raw logits
identity self-patch at L11 bitwise == fresh baseline
restoration: SA-sham: donor SA span (same-author duplicate, not recognized)
permuted: donor new span with a frozen position permutation
norm-matched random: Gaussian with each position rescaled to the donor new span's per-position L2 norm (seeded)
suppression: donor-side SA-sham: host SA span -> donor new
permuted: host new span permuted -> donor new
norm-matched random: Gaussian rescaled to host new span per-position norms -> donor new

gpu_status: 0 Stage-B forwards; requires the user's explicit approval of 464 calls / 4 x 116
host_selection_rule: Stage-A pattern FFF, accept cell, source group not a donor group, distinct groups, first 4 by scene_sha256; same hosts for every donor (crossed 4x4)
layer_rationale: outputs of full-attention layers 7/11/15 (hybrid 24-layer backbone, full attention every 4th layer); 11 = pilot replication (confirmatory), 7/15 = layer profile (exploratory); 23 excluded as a structural exact null
not_claimed: Key-only mediation (needs a separate K/Q component protocol)
never-seen source groups (tier-1 does not exist)

preregistered_analysis.confirmatory: layer 11, both directions: report supportive cells /16 and flips /16; the claim 'specific causal carrier at L11' needs supportive cells in all 3 donor source groups and all 4 host source groups in BOTH directions, and no control with as many flips as the main arm
preregistered_analysis.exploratory: layers 7 and 15 profile; certificate_action argmax changes; span norm/cosine statistics; per-donor and per-host breakdown
preregistered_analysis.independence: statistical unit = source group (3 donor groups, 4 host groups); the 16 cells are not independent; sign counts are descriptive
negative_outcomes: controls flip as often as the main arm -> no specificity claim
supportive only within one donor group -> no cross-group claim
restoration without suppression (or vice versa) -> report one-directional only
preregistered_analysis.readout: M = logit(conflicting_vote=true) - logit(false) on the C row; C = M > 0
preregistered_analysis.restoration_cell: (donor, host, layer): dM_x = M(host SA patched by x) - M(host SA baseline); SUPPORTIVE iff dM_main > max(dM_sasham, dM_permuted, dM_normrand); FLIP iff M(main) > 0
preregistered_analysis.suppression_cell: (donor, host, layer): dM_x = M(donor new patched by x) - M(donor new baseline); SUPPORTIVE iff dM_main < min(dM_donorside_sasham, dM_permuted, dM_normrand); FLIP iff M(main) < 0
